text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.18 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications includes experience with "REST API", "Node.js", and "Git". Key gaps include a lack of required experience in ruby, reactjs, sql, docker, ci/cd, and cloud computing, as well as having only 2.5 years of experience. Despite these missing requirements and low overall fit, the application has been escalated for further review.
